metadata.name: Bilingual Foundation
metadata.description: Internally-authored bilingual corpus (Chinese / English / Mixed) expanded for a stronger training signal across capability-oriented patterns: factual statements, explanations, bilingual mappings, and short conversational exchanges. Explicitly NOT production-scale and NOT a claim of fluent bilingual generation.
